test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In May 2022, the Inter-State Council, which works to promote and support cooperative federalism in the country, has been reconstituted. Who will be chairman of this council?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Inter-State Council, which works to promote and support cooperative federalism in the country, has been reconstituted with Prime Minister Narendra Modi as Chairman.
 
• The government has also reconstituted the standing committee of the Inter-State Council with Union Home Minister Amit Shah as Chairman.
 
• The Inter-State Council was set up through a Presidential Order on May 28, 1990.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It was set up through a presidential order on the recommendation of the Sarkaria Commission.
 
• Justice R. S. Sarkaria had recommended that a permanent Inter-State Council should be set up under Article 263.
 
• The Inter-State Council composes of the following members:
 
 
• Prime Minister, Chairman.
 
• Chief Ministers of all states.
 
• Chief Ministers of the union territories having legislative assemblies.
 
• Administrators of the union territories not having legislative assemblies.
 
• 6 Union Cabinet Ministers, including Home Minister, to be nominated by the Prime Minister.
 
• Governors of the states being administered under the President's rule.
